items.source: Note that Session.SESSION_TRANSACTED is not defined. It should be handled through a call to JmsAccessor.setSessionTransacted(boolean).
items.translation: 注意，Session.SESSION_TRANSACTED` 未定义。应通过调用 JmsAccessor.setSessionTransacted(boolean)` 来处理。

items.source: Creates an AcknowledgeMode of the given mode. The mode may be auto, client, dupsok or a non-standard acknowledge mode that can be parsed as an integer.
items.translation: 创建给定mode的。该模式可以是auto、client、dupsok，或是一个非标准的确认模式，可以解析为整数。

items.source: Messages are acknowledged once the message listener implementation has called Message.acknowledge(). This mode gives the application (rather than the JMS provider) complete control over message acknowledgement.
items.translation: 消息在消息监听器实现调用了Message.acknowledge()后得到确认。此模式使应用程序（而非 JMS 提供者）能够完全控制消息的确认。

items.source:
Messages sent or received from the session are automatically acknowledged. This is
the simplest mode and enables once-only message delivery guarantee.
items.translation: 从会话发送或接收的消息会自动确认。这是最简单的模式，可提供一次消息投递保证。

items.source:
Similar to auto acknowledgment except that said acknowledgment is lazy. As a
consequence, the messages might be delivered more than once. This mode enables
at-least-once message delivery guarantee.
items.translation: 与自动确认类似，但所述确认为惰性确认。因此，消息可能会被多次投递。此模式启用至少一次消息投递保证。
